No front door

Followers stay followers

A woman can save your posts for a year and never join an email list. Your free quiz is a start, but every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Every enquiry starts from zero

Someone can go from one reel to your waitlist with no idea how you work or what it costs. A class lets them hear you explain it first, so the ones who apply already trust you.

Capped by your hours

One doctor, one diary

Patient care only grows when you add hours. Patient care, content and speaking all compete for the same week, so growth stalls when your time does.

The women who trust your voice but aren't ready for 1:1 care today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

A $17 masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills a new signature program

Sound familiar?

You don't need more guesswork. You need clear answers.

  • You're a woman in your 40s or 50s who wants to understand what midlife changes really mean.
  • You've been told "it's just stress" or "it's just your age" and left with more questions than answers.
  • You're reading conflicting things online about hormones and don't know what to trust.
  • You want an expert who explains things plainly, so you can have a better conversation with your own doctor.

Here's what you'll learn

01

What perimenopause is

What changes in the years before menopause, when it can start, and why it's so often missed.

The less talked-about shifts in sleep, mood, focus and cycles, explained by a specialist.

03

What the evidence says about hormone therapy and other approaches, in plain English.

How to track what you notice and which questions to bring, so you leave with a plan.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"I'm an OBGYN, and I'm in perimenopause too"

Hook
"I'm a board-certified OBGYN and menopause specialist, and I'm in perimenopause too. Here's what I wish more women were told." (to camera, warm room, the same look as your profile photo)
Body
"Perimenopause can start years before menopause, and a lot of the changes aren't the ones people expect. When nobody explains that, women end up guessing. I'd rather you understand what's happening and walk into your appointment with the right questions." (simple captions, one point per line)
CTA
"I teach all of it in a live 60-minute class called Perimenopause, Decoded. It's $17 and there's a replay. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions to bring to your doctor"

Hook
"If you're heading to a midlife check-up, write these three questions down first." (Dr. Kudzai holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: could what I'm noticing be related to perimenopause? Two: what are all my options, and what does the evidence say about each? Three: what should I track before we meet again?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go much deeper in my $17 masterclass, Perimenopause, Decoded. Link below. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Myth or fact: midlife edition"

Hook
"Myth or fact? I'm an OBGYN, let's go." (quick cuts, text on screen for each myth)
Body
"'Menopause starts at 50 and that's it.' [Myth or fact, your answer]. 'Hormone therapy is the same for everyone.' [Your answer]. 'If your periods are regular, it can't be perimenopause.' [Your answer]. There's so much confusion out there, and you deserve clear information."
CTA
"I clear it all up in a live class called Perimenopause, Decoded. It's $17, with a replay. Tap Sign up. Educational content, not medical advice."
